motion.name: atmosphere-only
motion.value: Gust-driven petals, stronger harbor source-row refraction, faster coastal birds, broader advecting harbor mist and window light
motion.purpose: Move the atmosphere while preserving the original character and buildings.

motion.name: default-rate
motion.purpose: Host-controlled requestAnimationFrame clock clamped to 1-60 FPS; elapsed time is accumulated once. Pause, hidden document, reduced motion and speed zero stop the loop.

narrative.overview: This document describes this local wallpaper theme only. A detailed adult messenger sits above a fictional coastal town, with fine ink hatching, paper texture and restrained vermilion accents. The illustration remains stable while the surrounding atmosphere moves.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet motion around a stable character.

rules.name: The Face-Preserving Crop Rule
rules.body: Fill the viewport with a cover crop positioned at 65% horizontally and 50% vertically. Desktop retains the bay and messenger; portrait retains the face and seated pose while cropping peripheral scenery.

rules.name: The Stable Illustration Rule
rules.body: Keep the character, clothing, scarf and buildings undeformed. Motion belongs to the atmospheric overlays.

dos: Do preserve the face in portrait crops.
Do keep animation restrained and controlled by host lifecycle and reduced motion.
Do retain the prompt and provenance record with the original artwork.
donts: Don't add a HUD or deform the character illustration.
Don't substitute existing franchise imagery, manga scans or downloaded music.
Don't present generation provenance as a legal guarantee.
